notes.metaMaps: T49: one extra search per trace limited to factCheckDomains; up to two fact-check pages are read as meta nodes (never origins) and the pages they cite are read first. A page reached that way records foundViaMeta and still needs its own verbatim span. false turns it off.
notes.printCues: T37: case-insensitive patterns that show the earliest page credits print (an ISBN, page or volume numbers, a journal, a book, a dated study). A typed boundary of print counts only if one matches the sentence or the text around it.
notes.writtenCitationCues: #192 F4: case-insensitive patterns for an earlier source cited in words, each with a named group `year` that sits inside the cited phrase ('2009 issue of', 'published in 2013', 'a 2006 study'). When that year is before the page's own date, the page counts as citing earlier and is never an origin. A data year elsewhere in the span ('since 1988, according to the Carbon Majors Report') never counts. Set from dev-13's span on E2; E3 is not looked at.
notes.editableDomains: T37: pages anyone can edit. A typed boundary of unsourced counts only on one of these domains, and only when the page cites nothing beside the sentence.
notes.secondSameClaimModel: T79: a second Token Factory model family that answers same_claim beside Qwen; an origin then needs its yes too, and any other answer, or none, counts as unsure. null is off. It is switched on (deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Pro-0813) only if eval/same-claim/second-model.ts shows fewer false hits on E2 without losing true ones.
notes.injectionPatterns: T50: instruction-like text in a page, case-insensitive regular expressions. A page with one anywhere on it (the walker quotes it on the node) or in or around its span cannot be an origin, whatever the typed answers say. Written from the adversarial trap set, never from dev, spike or held-out pages.
notes.clusterSimilarityThreshold: Placeholder. Set on the E2 dev set (#34) before the held-out run; Rohan never edits it.
notes.otherNumberSimilarity: T97: cosine between the claim and a page sentence, on Qwen3-Embedding-8B vectors, at or above which a sentence that names the claim's subject with a different number is listed as the same claim with another number. Set to 0.75 from eval/drift/measure.ts on the 107 labelled E2 sentences (XO's live run, Nov 16): best F1 there, precision 0.82 and recall 0.64, against 0.71 and 0.36 at the old 0.8 placeholder. E3 is checked at this value with measure.ts --set=e3, never tuned on.

notes.maxQueriesPerHop: Placeholder cap on planned search queries per hop (T35). Set on the E2 dev set within the credit cap; never on spike or held-out claims.
